lines.trans: Dmitry, this was your stupid idea!
Stop shouting, it turned out a great show!
Rivals in life — rivals on screen.
You just wanted to make me angry.
And it worked, you got angry perfectly!
Now that woman will be in my kitchen.
She lost the bet and will work the shift honestly.
Viktor, get your cooks in order.
My cooks always work perfectly.
I shouldn't feel ashamed before the guests.
Don't worry, everything will be at the highest level.
Great, then I am calm about the restaurant.
I will go meet our new worker.
Good luck in the kitchen, chef!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.en: to meet, to greet, to pick up

examples.text: Вас и не должны были встречать.
examples.trans: Nobody was supposed to meet you.

examples.text: Он всегда встречает гостей у двери.
examples.trans: He always greets guests at the door.

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.
Everything is arranged at the highest level.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: in business, sport or an election

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I know this town really well!

отработать.gloss: to work off (a debt), to put in (hours)

meanings.en: to work off (a debt or favour), to pay back by working
to work (a shift or set time)

examples.text: Я тебе всё отработала на тех выборах.
examples.trans: I paid you back in full at that election.
I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?
Don't worry, everything will be fine.

получиться.gloss: to turn out, to work out

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: всё получилось = it all worked out

meanings.en: to come out of, to make
meanings.note: из тебя получится мэр = you'll make a mayor
по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.
Bring him tomorrow to the hospital.
The father brought his son to the doctor.

meanings.note: money, a game, a bet, or an election

examples.trans: I lost it on the stock exchange.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.trans: You angered the chief art director.

examples.text: Его резкие слова сильно разозлили шефа.
examples.trans: His sharp words infuriated the chef greatly.

разозлиться.gloss: to get angry, to lose one's temper

meanings.en: to get angry, to become furious

examples.text: Уйди от меня! Я сейчас разозлюсь!
examples.trans: Get away from me! I'm going to get angry right now!
He got very angry at his friend.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
morning or afternoon shift at school or work

examples.trans: We're on the afternoon shift today.
This is a bet, wager, dispute.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: Удачи! = Good luck! (genitive: 'I wish you luck')

examples.trans: That's a real stroke of luck.

meanings.note: impersonal, + genitive: денег не хватило = there wasn't enough money

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
Do you want me to tell you honestly?
It turned out to be a great culinary show.
An image appeared on the screen.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
